The GoJ achieved full enrollment of all children in custodial care in rehabilitation or reintegration programmes thus the target was achieved

title.narrative: Improve sector governance and governments financial capability to achieve sector policy objectives

description.narrative: Understanding and mutual respect among all the parties involved in the administration of justice will be enabled through formal collaboration mechanisms such as joint programming, training sessions, adhoc working groups/meetings and other opportunities to build and deepen relationships thus provide better services to users of the sector

title.narrative: Strengthened public trust and confidence

description.narrative: Public trust and confidence is cultivated in the justice system through increased transparency towards the public and public ownership of the justice system. Increased transparency is linked to wider anticorruption policies.

comment.narrative: Bill tabled in Parliament for the establishment of the Integrity Commission
Integrity Commission operational

The Integrity Commission has been established and its staff complement has remained at a functional level despite resignations thus the entity remained fully operational. The Annual Report for 20182019 was accepted and tabled in Parliament thus the indicator has been met. The ongoing operation of the Integrity Commission provides an additional level of governance to strengthen public trust and confidence.
